title: Page 2
lines: 路翔哽咽地垂下头，要不是那些执迷不悟的百姓，要不是至死不肯醒悟的祖上们，他路国如今怎会如此？而他的皇姊，又怎会为买张魂纸给她的皇弟，却因此而花光了她的嫁妆？他两手紧握着拳，极力想压下满心酸楚的感觉，倔强地不肯让悬在眼眶中的泪水脱眶而出。
“皇上，许愿吧。”看着他长大的赤水上前扶住了他摇晃的身子，恳求地低喃，“您就成全公主这一片爱弟之心吧……”
握在手中原本该是没有温度的纸张，在他们期盼的目光下，仿佛有了灼人的温度，路翔忍不住再将它握紧一点，就深怕失去了手中希望的温度。
当天晚上，回到锻日宫后，路翔静静地看了那张魂纸一夜。
面对着这张可引诱出人性最贪婪一面的纸张，原本路翔兴奋期待的心情就像一锅沸腾的热水，可在他发现，他愈是想要利用这张魂纸达成他的愿望，他也愈感到恐惧，一想到召出魂役所必须支付的代价，他的心情便彻底的冷静了下来。
凡事都有代价，若想要得，他就必须得先付出。
而他又能付出什么？
整整在锻日宫想了三日后，路翔在路露的催促下，谨慎地许下了愿望，接着便是满心雀跃地期待着魂役的到来。
许愿后次日，路翔找来路露与赤水，想不通地问。
“皇姊，你可知魂主许愿后，魂役何时会来到魂主身边？”怎么等了整整一夜，也没见着他的魂役前来找他报到？
“这个……”路露偏首看向赤水。
赤水仔细回想，“回皇上，臣听人说，大部分的魂役都会在第一时间内听从魂主的呼唤，以最快的速度来到魂主身边，所以应当用不了多久，皇上，您且再耐心些。”
“好吧，那咱们就再等等。”
只是恐怕就连赤水也都没料到，他们这么一等，就等了两年。
这两年来，路翔与路露无一日不站在宫门处等待出宫打听消息的赤水，就盼他能带回他们心心念念，那个能为路翔解决国内宗教问题，并将路国重新导至正轨的魂役。
可他始终都没有来。
直至那一日，赤水神情古怪地将他带至皇宫后门处，并在他耳畔叽叽咕咕许久后，为他引见了一名气质非凡，外貌看起来又仙气飘飘的年轻人。
“朕的魂役？”路翔诧异地瞪向来者，“确定是他？”
在赤水的解说中，路翔这才知道，这位自称是魂役者，名为顾醒，据说是来自于天上的半仙，于两年前被魂纸召唤出来时，便已来到了路国，降落之处就在皇宫外的京城南门口，而这位半仙，拖着慢吞吞的脚步，花了足有两年的时间，这才走到皇宫外。
京城南门口？
不是……才距离皇宫一里之遥吗？
这什么脚程？会不会慢得太离谱了些？
“皇上……”赤水在他盯着顾醒出神时，清楚地瞧见了顾醒面上的不悦，他连忙小声提醒。
路翔马上换上一张截然不同的面孔，张开了双臂、漾开最诚挚的笑容大声欢迎他。
“太好了，仙师您终于来了！”
站在宫门外一动也不动的顾醒，慢悠悠地挪正了身子，慢条斯理地将四周打量过一回，再极缓、极慢地，迎看向对他怀有满腔热情的路翔。
“朕盼着您的到来盼了好久……”路翔快步走下宫阶，欢天喜地的走向期待已久的救星，“朕就是您的魂主，希望您能为朕实现朕的心愿救我路国！”
然而响应他的，却是顾醒冷冷淡淡的嘲问。
“凭什么？”
顾醒不客气地戳破他的美梦，“谁告诉你，魂役定会实现魂主的愿望？”
路翔与赤水听了，当下皆怔愣在原地不知该如何是好。他们万万没料想到，日夜期盼的魂役，所为他们所带来的，竟会是这种情形。
“不……不是吗？”路翔心慌慌的问。
顾醒挑衅地扬起头一笑，“我就是不干，你又能奈我何？”
什么？！
原国，黄金门。
“依二师兄看，这差事该派谁去？”莫追一脸意外地盯着桌案信件，没想到师门接到的最新委托任务，竟是如此简单。
今年早早就找到魂纸后，莫追一回到师门，便被忙得不可开交的蓬莱给逮来办差，而他所接手的头一宗生意，便是路国皇帝向黄金门求聘一位武艺高强的保镖贴身保护。
坐在书案另一头的蓬莱攒着两眉不发一语，老早就看过此信的他眼下也正犹豫得很，而特地跑来书房凑热闹的容易坐在蓬莱的身旁，则想不通这件小事到底有什么好为难的。
“保镖？这差事师门里哪个人没做过？我听说四师姊昨日回师门了，不如就……”他想也不想地启口，却蓦地被蓬莱恶狠狠杀过来的眼神给瞪掉了后半截的话，他忙求救地看向对面的莫追。
岂料莫追也是一头雾水，“呃，不知……四师姊又干了啥事？”
他不开口还好，他这么一说，蓬莱登时便像个被点着了的炮仗。
莫追与容易在瞧见他风云骤变的脸色后，当下心中一沉，随即默契十足地同时出手抬起沉重的书案，然后速速闪到一边，让正想拍桌的蓬莱高扬着手却找不到桌可拍，只能出气地重重往地上猛跺脚，让才又刚铺好没多久的青金石地板又碎了一地。
蓬莱使劲地往地上踩了一脚又一脚，“她敢出门掳男人、剥光男人、还画男人，我就敢捆了她！这回我非剁了她的手把扔她到佛堂去念经不可！”
“又由大师兄亲自监督？”莫追无奈地看着一地由他造成的狼籍。
“正是！”保证凶残的大师兄绝对能把她剥下一层皮来！
容易告饶地抚着额，“二师兄，不是我要说你，都这么多年了，你怎还是没半点长进？”啧啧，亏他精得跟猴似的，都没学到教训吗？
莫追同样不敢苟同地摇首，“哪儿不扔偏又往佛堂扔？难不成二师兄你到现在还不明白，每回四师姊只要自佛堂受苦受难出来，浴火重生的她，下一本小黄书就会变本加厉，色得更上一层楼？”
“臭小子，连你也看？”蓬莱气势凶猛地将头一转，气急败坏地瞪着这名竟敢同流合污的小师弟。
莫追委屈地拉着衣袖抹泪，“谁教师姊太无良，我是被逼的……”看了会被二师兄碎碎念，不看会被四师姊追着扁，他当然选择站在比较没有良心的四师姊这边。
“你呢？”蓬莱扭过头瞪向同样素行不良的五师弟。
“老子才不看那污人眼的玩意儿！”容易撇撇嘴，不屑地以鼻孔看人，“不过我听说，师门里里外外的人在四师姊的淫威下，都已差不多看了个遍，二师兄你节哀。”
蓬莱听了，脑海中名唤为理智的那根弦当下便绷的一声，断了。
他将十指扳得格格作响，语调骤然变得温柔和煦有如春风徐徐轻拂，“去，你们两个去把老四给我叫来……”
某二人神情一致地晾着白眼。
“她不来呢？”那只泼皮是他们动嘴皮子说说就能请来的？她要没别的本事，这些年来也不会老让诸国皇帝都恨她恨得牙痒痒了。
“捆、来！”蓬莱直接掏出怀中代掌门的令牌朝他们砸过去。
“得令！”
“慢着。”蓬莱在他俩幸灾乐祸地往门外跑时添了一句，“等会儿顺便派个人去把小六叫过来。”
“是。”就在他们两人连手与月穹打了一场，再拿出代掌门令威胁月穹束手就擒后，容易与莫追乐不可支地将月穹从头到脚给捆了个结实，还不忘将代掌门令塞进她的嘴里堵住她的絮絮叨叨，合力将她扛到书房后，他俩便把她扔给蓬莱，然后关上门交给蓬莱去收拾了。
content_en:
Lu Xiang choked and lowered his head. If it weren't for those stubborn people, if it weren't for the ancestors who refused to wake up until death, how could the Lu country be like this now? And how could his imperial sister spend all her dowry to buy a soul paper for her imperial brother? He clenched his fists with both hands, trying his best to suppress the feeling of sadness in his heart, and stubbornly refused to let the tears hanging in his eyes escape.
"Your Majesty, make a wish." Chishui, who had watched him grow up, stepped forward to support his swaying body and murmured imploringly, "Please fulfill the princess' love for a brother..."
The paper that was supposed to be temperatureless in his hands seemed to have a scorching temperature under their expectant gazes. Lu Xiang couldn't help but hold it tighter, for fear of losing the hoped-for warmth in his hands.
That night, after returning to the Forging Sun Palace, Lu Xiang quietly looked at the soul paper all night.
Facing this piece of paper that could seduce the most greedy side of human nature, Lu Xiang's mood of excitement and anticipation was like a pot of boiling hot water. But when he discovered that the more he wanted to use this soul paper to achieve his wish, the more fear he felt. When he thought of the price he had to pay to summon the soul servant, his mood completely calmed down.
Everything has a price, and if he wants to get it, he must pay first.
And what can he give?
After thinking about it in the Sun Palace for three days, Lu Xiang cautiously made his wish at Lu Lu's urging, and then he looked forward to the arrival of the Soul Service with great joy.
The next day after making the wish, Lu Xiang came to Lu Lu and Chishui and asked confusedly.
"Emperor Sister, do you know when the soul servant will come to the soul master after the soul master makes a wish?" Why did he not see his soul servant coming to report to him after waiting all night?
"This..." Lu Lu turned her head and looked at Chishui.
Chishui thought about it carefully, "Back to the Emperor, I heard that most of the soul servants will obey the soul master's call as soon as possible and come to the soul master as quickly as possible, so it shouldn't take long. Your Majesty, please be more patient."
"Okay, then let's wait."
But I'm afraid even Chishui didn't expect that they had been waiting for two years.
In the past two years, Lu Xiang and Lu Lu stood at the palace gate every day, waiting for Chishui to leave the palace to inquire about the news, hoping that he could bring back the soul servant they had longed for, who could solve Lu Xiang's domestic religious problems and bring Lu Country back on track.
But he never came.
Until that day, Chishui brought him to the back door of the palace with a strange expression, and after chattering in his ears for a long time, he introduced him to a young man with extraordinary temperament and fairy-like appearance.
"My soul servant?" Lu Xiang stared at the visitor in surprise, "Are you sure it's him?"
During Chishui's explanation, Lu Xiang learned that this self-proclaimed soul slave named Gu Xing was a semi-immortal from the sky. When he was summoned by the soul paper two years ago, he had already arrived in the Lu Kingdom and landed at the south gate of the capital outside the palace. It took this semi-immortal two years to walk slowly outside the palace.
The south gate of Beijing?
Isn't it... just one mile away from the palace?
What kind of routine is this? Is it too slow?
"Your Majesty..." Chishui clearly saw the displeasure on Gu Xing's face when he was staring at Gu Xing in trance, and he quickly reminded him in a low voice.
Lu Xiang immediately put on a completely different face, opened his arms, and welcomed him loudly with the most sincere smile.
"Great, Master Immortal, you are finally here!"
Gu Xing, who was standing motionless outside the palace gate, slowly straightened his body, looked around slowly, and then very slowly, very slowly, he looked at Lu Xiang, who was full of enthusiasm for him.
"I have been looking forward to your arrival for a long time..." Lu Xiang walked down the palace steps quickly and happily walked towards the long-awaited savior. "I am your soul master. I hope you can fulfill my wish and save my country!"
However, what responded to him was Gu Xing's cold and indifferent ridicule.
"Why?"
Gu Xing rudely exposed his sweet dream, "Who told you that the soul servant will definitely fulfill the soul master's wish?"
After Lu Xiang and Chishui heard this, they were both stunned and didn't know what to do. They never expected that the soul service they had been looking forward to day and night would bring them such a situation.
"No...isn't it?" Lu Xiang asked in a panic.
Gu Xing raised his head provocatively and smiled, "I just won't do it, what can you do to me?"
What? !
Original country, golden gate.
"Second Senior Brother, who should be sent on this errand?" Mo Zhui stared at the letter on the desk with a surprised look on his face. He did not expect that the latest commissioned task received by the sect would be so simple.
After finding the soul paper early this year, as soon as Mo Zhui returned to his master's door, he was arrested by the extremely busy Penglai on errands. The first business he took over was when the Emperor of Lu State asked the Golden Gate to hire a bodyguard with high martial arts skills for personal protection.
Penglai, who was sitting on the other side of the desk, frowned and said nothing. He had read this letter a long time ago and was hesitating. Yi Yi, who had come to the study to join in the fun, sat next to Penglai and couldn't figure out what was so embarrassing about this little thing.
"Bodyguard? Who in the division has never done this? I heard that the fourth senior sister returned to the division yesterday, why not..." He started to speak without thinking, but was suddenly stunned by Penglai's fierce and murderous eyes. He looked at Mo Zhui opposite for help.
Unexpectedly, Mo Zhui was also confused, "Uh, I wonder... what did the fourth senior sister do again?"
It was a good thing that he didn't speak. When he said this, Penglai suddenly felt like a firecracker being lit.
After Mo Zhui and Yi Yi saw his sudden change of expression, their hearts sank. Then they lifted up the heavy bookcase at the same time with a tacit understanding, and then quickly stepped aside. Penglai, who was about to pat the table, raised his hands but couldn't find the table to pat on. They could only stomp their feet on the ground in anger, causing the lapis lazuli floor that had just been laid to shatter again.
Penglai stomped on the ground one after another, "If she dares to go out and kidnap men, strip them naked, and paint men, I dare to tie her up! This time I have to chop off her hands and throw her to the Buddhist hall to chant sutras!"
"Again, Senior Brother will supervise it personally?" Mo Zhui helplessly looked at the mess he had caused.
"Exactly!" I guarantee that the cruel senior brother can definitely peel off a layer of her skin!
He stroked his forehead easily and said, "Second Senior Brother, I'm not going to tell you, after all these years, why haven't you made any progress?" Tsk, tusk, he's as smart as a monkey, hasn't he learned his lesson?
Mo Zhui also shook his head in disbelief, "Throwing it somewhere and then throwing it into the Buddhist hall? Is it possible, Second Senior Brother, that you still don't understand that every time Fourth Senior Sister comes out of the Buddhist Hall to suffer hardships and is reborn from the ashes, the next little pornographic book will become even more serious and even more erotic?"
"You brat, are you even looking at this?" Penglai turned his head fiercely and glared angrily at this junior fellow apprentice who dared to join in the evil deeds.
Mo Zhui pulled his sleeves and wiped away his tears in grievance, "Who is the teacher sister who is so unscrupulous? I was forced to..." After seeing this, he would be thought to pieces by the second senior brother, but he would not be chased by the fourth senior sister. Of course, he chose to side with the more unscrupulous fourth senior sister.
"What about you?" Penglai turned his head and glared at the fifth junior brother who also had bad behavior.
"I don't look at those dirty things!" Yi Yi curled his lips and looked at people with his nostrils disdainfully, "But I heard that everyone inside and outside the master's sect has almost seen it all under the power of the Fourth Senior Sister. Second Senior Brother, please forgive me."
After Penglai heard this, the string called reason in his mind immediately tensed and broke.
He rattled his fingers, and his tone suddenly became gentle and warm, like the gentle spring breeze, "Go, you two go and call me the fourth child..."
The two of them rolled their eyes in unison.
"What if she doesn't come?" Can they invite that rogue just by talking? If she had no other abilities, she wouldn't have made the emperors of all the countries hate her so much over the years.
"Come here!" Penglai took out the token of the acting head and threw it at them.
"Got the order!"
"Wait a minute." Penglai added as they gloated about their misfortune and ran out the door, "Send someone to call Xiao Liu over later."
"Yes." After the two of them joined hands to fight Yue Qiong, and then threatened Yue Qiong with the acting head order, Yi Yi and Mo Zhui tied Yue Qiong tightly from head to toe in joy. They did not forget to stuff the acting head order into her mouth to stop her babble. After working together to carry her to the study, they threw her to Penglai, then closed the door and left it to Penglai to clean up.
